statements.t: As of September 30, 2026, the Company had temporarily closed one of its Canadian stores for relocation and we anticipate to open this store in Q4 2026.
We will also continue to selectively invest in profitable sales growth where it makes sense, but rebuilding a durable, profitable business model is the highest priority.

Gross profit increased by $3.8 million, or 12.0%, compared to the same period in 2025, and our gross margin percentage for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, increased year over year by 450 basis points, of which approximately 100 basis points is due to tariff refunds received in the third quarter of 2026, which we do not expect to recur.

Our effective income tax rate for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 and September 30, 2025 was 29.5% and 25.1% respectively and are primarily due to improvement in our projected taxable income in 2026 and the recognition of tax benefits on the sales of our corporate property in 2025, partially offset by forecasted income taxes loss projected due to our 2025 operation and certain foreign and state…
We expect to fund our operating and liquidity needs primarily from a combination of current cash balances and cash generated from operating activities.
Any excess cash will be invested as determined by our Board of Directors in accordance with its approved investment policy.
The global tariff environment is changing rapidly, and we cannot be assured that we will not be materially negatively impacted by these changes .

Excluding buildout, furniture, equipment and other costs associated with the move to the new facilities, the Company expects to pay combined rent for new headquarters and flagship store facilities in excess of $1.6 million per year (adjusted for inflation annually over the term).
